title: Secure partner project + data-use agreement + agreed rule packs / generalization defaults
context: Securing a real partner is the critical-path dependency for delivering an actual good deed rather than infrastructure. A partner counts as secured only with all three of: a signed data-use agreement, a named accountable contact, and a passing acceptance test on a sample cleaned output. Generalization defaults, sensitivity list, and taxonomic backbone are agreed jointly. A no-partner fallback exists but does not meet Definition of Shipped. Depends on csp-partner-004.
objective: Secure a partner project by obtaining a signed data-use agreement + named contact + passing acceptance test, and jointly agree and record the generalization defaults, sensitivity list, and taxonomic backbone (or invoke the documented fallback).
acceptanceCriteria: Secured requires all three: signed DUA, a named accountable contact, and a passing acceptance test on a sample cleaned output
Generalization defaults (grid resolution, date granularity, suppression rules), sensitivity list, and taxonomic backbone are agreed and recorded jointly
Fallback if no partner: run on a fully openly-licensed public dataset + publish output + manifest + datasheet + commission an independent expert spot-check (does not meet Definition of Shipped)
verifiedNeed flips to true only once the partner is secured per all three criteria
output: docs/partner/data-use-agreement-and-agreed-defaults.md recording the DUA, named contact, acceptance-test result, and the jointly agreed generalization/sensitivity/backbone defaults.
